main_text.l: fuerit è valuis domus tuæ foras, san-
guis eius erit in caput eius, nos vero
in domo, sanguis illius in caput nostrū
si manus iniecta fuerit in eum.
hunc nostrum, erimus innoxii à iura-
ita sit. Tunc dimisit eos, & abierunt,
qui quæsierunt per omnem viam nec
nerunt que ad Iosue filiū Nun, & nar-
Iehoua in manus nostras totā terram.

page.notes: Catchword "Diffo-" printed at the lower right; the small mark at the lower left is a stain, not text. The "ꝰ" and printer's spellings such as "reuerterentur" are kept as printed.
